init.title: Connection settings
init.description: Update the panel connection, credentials and connection method. Saving authenticates with the panel and reloads the integration. Keep the connection open to reuse authentication with a keepalive every 5 seconds, or turn it off to connect and disconnect on every 30-second status poll.

error.invalid_auth: The panel rejected the user code.
error.invalid_config: Check host, port, hexadecimal APPID, passphrase and numeric user code.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to authenticate with the panel. Check connectivity and the direct passphrase.

user.title: Connect to Tecnoalarm
user.description: Read-only direct panel access. Authentication is required. APPID is hexadecimal; user code must contain 4–6 digits.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tecnoalarm
reconfigure.description: Update the direct panel connection and credentials. Saving authenticates with the panel and reloads the integration.
